title: Ballard Power Reports 45% Revenue Decline Amid Slowing Hydrogen Adoption, Shares Dip
description: Ballard Power Systems reported a 45% year-over-year decline in Q3 revenue, missing analyst estimates, due to weak customer demand and a push-out in the adoption of hydrogen and PEM fuel cells. The company's adjusted EBITDA loss widened, and it initiated a global restructuring to reduce costs.

title: Green Hydrogen Market Projected to Reach USD 78,134.07 Million by 2032, Growing at a CAGR of 39.83% From 2024-2032 | Introspective Market Research
